desc: Derive directed-edge arm DP states and prove that every alkane is uniquely represented by a degree-4 center with four disjoint arms.
Compute all directed messages efficiently for both orientations of every edge without quadratic recomputation.
Combine the best four distinct arms at each center and account for the center vertex.
Implement the algorithm iteratively in Python for \(N \le 2\cdot 10^5\), including impossible cases and edge cases.
Verify the implementation against the samples and structural cases such as a single degree-4 center, paths, and vertices of degree greater than four.
